segments.name: printing services and manufacture of business forms
segments.description: Manufactures and sells custom and semi-custom business forms and printed products through independent distributors.
segments.evidence: We operate approximately 50 manufacturing plants throughout the United States in 20 strategically located states as one reportable segment; printing services and manufacture of business forms.

revenueModel.text: Independent distributors, commercial printers, direct mail and fulfillment companies purchase printed products for resale to end users.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell predominantly through independent distributors, as well as to many of our competitors.

changes.text: In 2025, acquired CFC Print & Mail, Northeastern Envelope Company, and Envelope Superstore to strengthen business products and envelope capabilities.
changes.evidence: On November 14, 2025, we acquired the assets and business of CFC Print & Mail ("CFC") in Grand Prairie, Texas.

changes.text: In 2024, acquired Printing Technologies, Inc. to strengthen production capabilities and diversify product offerings.
changes.evidence: On June 26, 2024, we acquired the assets and business of Printing Technologies, Inc. ("PTI") in Indianapolis, Indiana.
